title: Insider describes place where bodies are stored

tellings.quote: One of them has talked about a place in which bodies are stored where they stored.

plain: A former military or intelligence insider has described a place where bodies are stored, the claim goes, without saying where. The researcher known online as UAPGerb tells Michels this as something one of several unnamed insiders told him. If true, it would mean bodies of some kind are being kept in secret.
